senses.gloss: f. pl. (a jocular denom. of <cite ref="S00070"><he>קַבָּלָה</he></cite>, adopted fr.
units: Ex. XXVI, 5) founded on tradition; contrad. to מַקְרִילוֹת a corresponding feigned denom. of מִקְרָא, founded on the Bible. Y. B. Kam. VIII, end, 6ᶜ הָן תניתה אילין לָמַ׳ לָמַ׳ (= לָא מַ׳) where didst thou learn these things, founded neither on Bible nor on tradition?
